critical_code_review_comments: security_agent/actions.py:extend() uses minutes_from_now (expires_at = _now() + minutes), so extend(minutes=1) effectively truncates a 60-min block to 1 min — this is intentional and matches the review contract, but the public endpoint /extend body field name 'minutes' is ambiguous. Consider renaming to 'minutes_from_now' or adding a doc note in the API docstring, otherwise an admin pressing EXTEND +60 will unexpectedly RESET (not add) time.

security_agent/actions.py:undo() for revoke_sessions raises ValueError('revoked sessions cannot be restored'). This surfaces as HTTP 409 per routes/security_agent_routes.py mapping — correct, but admin UI should special-case this message so it isn't shown as a generic retry-able 'conflict'.

routes/security_agent_routes.py:_ser() drops expires_at if it's not already an ISO string. For /blocks that's handled explicitly, but any future endpoint that returns a BSON datetime through _ser() silently loses the field — worth a comment or helper that always ISO-formats.
routes/security_agent_routes.py:extend_action() validates minutes in [0, 10080] which rejects 99999 as expected (400). Good. Negative values are also implicitly rejected by `0 <= body.minutes`.

security_agent/actions.py:sweep() dedup is `dedup=<finding>|<rule>|<target>` + 'at within last hour' OR an existing status=done row. The 'status=done' branch means once undone, the agent CAN re-contain the same finding within the same hour (good — undo must not permanently disarm). Verified live: after undo, the sweep did not immediately re-block because the recent 'at within last hour' row still exists; this matches the review request's dedup caveat.

BridgeHeartbeat Pydantic model requires balance AND equity floats in addition to bridge_token — a payload missing them 422s and would NEVER emit bridge_invalid_token events (initial version of the test did this and got 0 x 401 instead of 34).
